package.description: Manage local, NAS and cloud files through a browser

en-US.description: Manage local, NAS and cloud files through a browser
en-US.longDescription:
remotefs provides a browser-based file manager and JSON API for local folders,
SMB shares, NFS exports and optional rclone cloud storage. Add cloud connections
in the GUI or CLI and copy files and folders between storage connections.
Features include password sign-in, uploads, text editing, saved locations,
network scanning and staged multipart ZIP downloads. Optional libvirt support
provides read-only storage inventory. Mount on this computer shows a share,
export or cloud connection as a drive letter that reconnects after restarts and
sign-in. The portable package includes Python, libnfs and rclone; WinFsp is
installed as a dependency for drive letters.
en-US.name: remotefs
